statement: In a single-seed MicroLens development ladder, M4 had the highest controlled-cold validation NDCG@20 while M7 had the highest FIT-warm validation NDCG@20; neither variant led both slices.
limitation: Cross-references M0-M7 receipts; no equal HPO, seed qualification, paired intervals, or protected outcome access. This is not a promotion claim.

statement: A three-epoch CUDA GRU4Rec pilot measured validation NDCG@20 of 0.008925 on 41,694 FIT-history MicroLens users.
limitation: No HPO, reference parity, seed qualification, or locked result. The historical pilot drew training negatives from source-wide first-observed items, so FIT-hidden cold IDs may have received negative updates; no cold-start or qualified comparator claim follows.

statement: The one-epoch MMRec BM3 architecture pilot scored zero controlled-cold NDCG@20 on 918 first-event MicroLens validation examples.
limitation: One epoch, one seed, no equal-budget HPO or baseline qualification. BM3 reference inference uses graph/ID embeddings; this is not a qualified cold comparator.
prohibited_stronger_formulation: BM3 cannot handle cold items or MOSAIC outperforms a qualified BM3 baseline.

statement: The local PixelRec50K publisher image and MiniLM text feature indices align on all 82,865 track items, with finite vectors and mapped tag/title-presence fields.
limitation: This is local feature QA, not image-encoder parity, historical content-time validity, a model result, or permission to redistribute derived vectors.
prohibited_stronger_formulation: PixelRec multimodal replication passed or raw covers were independently encoded.

statement: MOSAIC improves controlled cold NDCG@20 while retaining warm quality.
limitation: MOSAIC finalist, comparators, margins, locked results, and paired bootstrap are not available.

statement: MOSAIC has calibrated reliability-aware gate behavior.
limitation: Intervention and directional gate tests are not complete; gate weights are not probabilities.
Public observational offline data cannot establish production effect.
Only one physical GPU is available and no multi-GPU measurement exists.
